title: BookMySeat
description: Traffic, bookings, payments, email and JVM health of BookMySeat (metrics pushed over OTLP)

targets.expr: 100 * sum ((increase(http_server_requests_milliseconds_count{job="BookMySeat",status=~"5.."}[$__range]) and http_server_requests_milliseconds_count{job="BookMySeat",status=~"5.."} offset $__range) or last_over_time(http_server_requests_milliseconds_count{job="BookMySeat",status=~"5.."}[$__range])) / clamp_min(sum ((increase(http_server_requests_milliseconds_count{job="BookMySeat"}[$__range]) and http_server_requests_milliseconds_count{job="BookMySeat"} offset $__range) or last_over_time(http_server_requests_milliseconds_count{job="BookMySeat"}[$__range])), 1)

panels.title: p95 latency

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) ((increase(http_server_requests_milliseconds_bucket{job="BookMySeat"}[$__range]) and http_server_requests_milliseconds_bucket{job="BookMySeat"} offset $__range) or last_over_time(http_server_requests_milliseconds_bucket{job="BookMySeat"}[$__range])))

panels.description: 95% of requests were faster than this (from 50 ms … 5 s buckets, so it is approximate)

panels.title: Bookings
panels.description: Estimated by Prometheus from per-minute samples

panels.title: Booking value
panels.description: Confirmed bookings at what was paid, cancellations not subtracted; estimated from per-minute samples

panels.title: Emails waiting
panels.description: Outbox emails not delivered yet (latest value)

panels.title: Latency
panels.description: Approximate: interpolated between the 50 ms … 5 s buckets

targets.expr: sum by (category) ((increase(bookings_seats_total{job="BookMySeat"}[$__range]) and bookings_seats_total{job="BookMySeat"} offset $__range) or last_over_time(bookings_seats_total{job="BookMySeat"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Check-ins

targets.expr: sum by (result) ((increase(checkins_total{job="BookMySeat"}[$__range]) and checkins_total{job="BookMySeat"} offset $__range) or last_over_time(checkins_total{job="BookMySeat"}[$__range]))

panels.description: ok = let in; everything else is a refusal at the door

panels.title: Holds and conflicts per minute
panels.description: lock_lost = two people confirmed the same seat at the same moment; one of them lost

panels.title: Payments

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) ((increase(payments_total{job="BookMySeat"}[$__range]) and payments_total{job="BookMySeat"} offset $__range) or last_over_time(payments_total{job="BookMySeat"}[$__range]))

panels.description: refund = paid, but the seats were gone or the booking was cancelled

panels.title: Refunds

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) ((increase(refunds_total{job="BookMySeat"}[$__range]) and refunds_total{job="BookMySeat"} offset $__range) or last_over_time(refunds_total{job="BookMySeat"}[$__range]))

panels.description: manual = Razorpay refused an extra-payment refund: do it from the Razorpay dashboard

panels.title: Query time
panels.description: Time per SQL statement made by a request (Neon is in the same region; the jobs' polling isn't counted)

panels.title: Connection held per use
panels.description: How long a request keeps a pooled connection. Well above the query time means work inside a transaction that doesn't need the database (a login once held one through its 1.3 s password check)

panels.title: Waiting for a connection
panels.description: Above zero means the pool (5 connections in production) was all in use

panels.title: Connection timeouts
panels.description: Requests that gave up waiting for a free connection (they failed)

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Drops to zero at each start: on Render's free plan that is every wake-up after 15 idle minutes

panels.title: Log warnings and errors per minute
Last start
panels.description: Time from JVM start until the app was ready, for the most recent start in the range

panels.title: Processes
panels.description: Processes that ran in the range: each wake-up after sleep, deploy or restart is a new one

panels.title: Time until ready, per start
panels.description: One flat segment per process: the higher, the slower that cold start
